Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 26-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai), a prestigious government institution. It offers a great opportunity for candidates seeking government jobs in the research sector.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Junior Research Fellow. This position is ideal for individuals looking to contribute to research projects at a leading IIT.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post in this recruitment. Candidates should ensure their application is strong to stand out.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIT Bhilai JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the IIT Bhilai Junior Research Fellow Recruitment is 26 August 2026. Applicants are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow post is Rs. 37,000 + HRA (20%) per month. This competitive stipend is offered to selected candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET or GATE or other national level examinations.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without any cost.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Junior Research Fellow at IIT Bhilai?
faq.answer: The selection process for Junior Research Fellow at IIT Bhilai involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview. Candidates will be informed about the interview schedule.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF in the "Important Links" section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment process.
